name: consultation-report
title: Consultation evidence report: private draft
for_each: select id,name from projects order by name

sections.title: Scope
sections.sql: select name,owner,purpose from projects where id=$1

sections.title: Engagement record
sections.sql: select s.name as stakeholder,i.occurred_on,i.channel,i.note,i.actor from interactions i join stakeholders s on s.id=i.stakeholder_id where i.project_id=$1 order by i.occurred_on

sections.title: Issues and responses
sections.sql: select stakeholder,issue,severity,status,resolution from issue_register where project_id=$1 order by due_on

sections.title: Commitments
sections.sql: select stakeholder,commitment,owner,due_on,status,evidence from commitment_register where project_id=$1 order by due_on

name: commitment-letter
title: Commitment follow-up: private draft
for_each: select id,name from stakeholders where exists(select 1 from commitments c where c.stakeholder_id=stakeholders.id and status='open') order by name

sections.title: Recipient record
sections.sql: select name,organisation from stakeholders where id=$1
sections.note: Review before sharing. This document has not been sent.

sections.title: Agreed commitments needing follow-up
sections.sql: select name,owner,due_on from commitments where stakeholder_id=$1 and status='open' order by due_on
